issues.evidence: Both staged editions state that October US CPI is due on 10 November and unavailable at the 9 November cutoff. The US Bureau of Labor Statistics released October CPI on 10 November 2026: CPI-U rose 0.4% month over month seasonally adjusted and the index excluding food and energy rose 0.3%. The release did not provide the usual 12-month rate because October 2025 data were unavailable. As of this QA review on 25 November, the report's central upcoming-release framing is superseded.
